GroupCanvas.TemporaryHint.zh: 将当前组合或创作画布作为子工程，使用自己的原点与预览配置独立编辑
GroupCanvas.TemporaryHint.en: Edit the current group or drawing canvas independently, using its own origin and preview settings

GroupCanvas.RootHint.zh: 显示完整根工程，并仅编辑当前层级和创作画布
GroupCanvas.RootHint.en: Show the complete root project while editing only the current level and drawing canvas

GroupCanvas.TemporaryNotice.zh: 独立预览当前层级；预览透视不会改变它在根工程中的放置。
GroupCanvas.TemporaryNotice.en: Preview the current level independently. Preview perspective does not change its placement in the root project.

GroupCanvas.RootNotice.zh: 显示完整根工程；选中和编辑仅限当前层级和创作画布。
GroupCanvas.RootNotice.en: Show the complete root project. Selection and edits stay within the current level and drawing canvas.

GroupCanvas.EditPreviewInIndependent.zh: 请切换到独立画布，编辑当前子工程的预览设置。
GroupCanvas.EditPreviewInIndependent.en: Switch to Independent canvas to edit this subproject's preview settings.

GroupCanvas.ReadOnly.zh: 正在只读浏览离线快照，不能修改内容。
GroupCanvas.ReadOnly.en: This offline snapshot is read-only. Its content cannot be changed.

GroupCanvas.ReadOnlyNotice.zh: 源文件不可用，正在只读浏览离线快照；解除为普通组后可编辑。
GroupCanvas.ReadOnlyNotice.en: The source file is unavailable. This offline snapshot is read-only; detach it as a group to edit.
